title: Pneumatic probe for handling flat objects

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.quote: As shown in FIG. 1, a probe device 10 in accordance with the invention consists simply of a tube 11 having an input orifice 12 and an output orifice 13.
features.note: The reference describes a probe device as a tube, which can be considered a hollow body for gripping.
features.refuted: The quote describes a simple tube, not a housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The reference describes a pneumatically operated probe that uses an air-flow, but does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes air-flow through a probe duct to create a pressure differential for lifting objects, but does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: The output orifice is surrounded by a flange 14, a flat disc-like collar member which is disposed substantially at right angles to the duct 11.
features.note: The reference describes a flange surrounding the output orifice, which acts as a contact surface, but it does not explicitly mention a separate carrier plate or a seal in the sense of an elastomeric gasket.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: The reference describes a pneumatically operated probe with a hollow body, but lacks an electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routing through the grip, and sound-damping.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: A pneumatically powered probe for handling and positioning flat objects comprising, in combination, a probe duct having an input and an output end, a flange member surrounding said output end
features.note: The probe itself acts as the grip unit, and the flange member functions as the suction plate, combined in a single apparatus.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a probe duct and flange member but does not teach a grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference describes a pneumatic probe that uses air-flow to create a pressure differential, but does not describe a distinct vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing devices or materials.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference describes a probe as a single tube with a flange, not an elongated grip portion between distinct housing portions with an air outlet on a second portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw or any mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles for directing exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference describes a pneumatically powered probe and does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes the probe as a single unit where the flange (suction plate) is integral with the tube (grip unit), not releasably connected.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: a probe duct having an input and an output end, a flange member surrounding said output end, means for directing an air-flow through said duct therebyto form an area reduced in pressure
features.note: The probe duct (grip unit) is fluidically connected to the area between the flange (suction plate) and the object, which acts as a suction chamber.
features.refuted: The quote describes air-flow creating reduced pressure but does not teach a grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes a pneumatic probe for handling flat objects, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.
This reference describes a pneumatic probe, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference does not mention a sound-damping device or a grip portion.
This reference does not mention a grip portion or sound-damping material.
This reference does not mention a vacuum generating device or a housing portion.
This reference does not mention a sound-reducing device, a housing portion, or sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a pneumatic probe for handling flat objects, not a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions with an air outlet on the second housing portion.
The reference does not describe an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion for collecting exhaust air.
The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air emerging from a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference does not describe a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.
The reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: A PNEUMATICALLY POWDERED PROBE FOR HANDLING AND POSITIONING FLAT OBJECTS COMPRISING, IN COMBINATION, A PROBE DUCT HAVING AN INPUT AND AN OUTPUT END, A FLANGE MEMBER SURROUNDING SAID OUTPUT END, MEANS FOR DIRECTING AN AIR-FLOW THROUGH SAID DUCT THEREBY TO
claims.note: The reference discloses a pneumatically powered probe for handling objects using reduced pressure, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus. However, it does not explicitly use the term "vacuum handling apparatus" and the mechanism described is a Bernoulli-type pressure differential rather than a traditional vacuum.

The reference describes a flange member surrounding an output end of a probe duct, but it does not disclose a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around the carrier plate.
The reference does not disclose a 'grip unit according to claim 1' as claim 1 is not provided in the context of this reference.

claims.note: The reference describes a probe duct and flange creating a low-pressure area to lift an object, which is analogous to a suction opening and suction chamber for generating a vacuum. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' or a 'suction opening' within a grip unit.

overall.why: The reference describes a pneumatic probe for handling flat objects using Bernoulli's principle, which shares some functional similarities with a vacuum handling apparatus, particularly regarding the use of a probe/grip and a flange/suction plate to create a pressure differential for lifting.
